items.title: Australian influencer Lily Jay’s tangled web of AI manipulation
items.description: Receiving millions of views online, the Lily Jay Foundation claims to help children across the world. She was even given an award for her work. But what is real and what is AI-generated? ABC NEWS Verify investigates.

items.title: Thai teenager allegedly murdered by Australian man had a 'tough life'
items.description: While the public will remember Thai teenager Tunchanok Donhomla for the tragic nature of her death, her aunt, Mee Boonsert, will remember the baby she helped raise.

items.title: Dentists see complications as Australians seek overseas treatments
items.description: Janelle Jeal thought having dental care overseas would be life changing. It was, but for the wrong reasons.

items.title: Australia's spy agency turns to Vogue to find recruits
items.description: A security industry insider tells the ABC the agency cannot afford to "just hire dweebs" as ASIS pivots to a new recruitment strategy aimed at women.

items.title: Socceroos match shows where Labor's gambling ad laws fall short

items.title: Investors consider class action over super scam

items.title: Crowds gather in Iran to farewell body of assassinated supreme leader

items.title: For 60 years, Play School has never broken this rule

items.title: Bird flu threatens to devastate seabird population on Great Barrier Reef

items.title: How NAIDOC grew from a one-day protest to a week-long celebration

items.title: Taylor Swift's wedding a lesson in 'media mastery'

items.title: It's time for your weekly spelling check-up
